craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 8. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 6. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Of one struck by a ḍimba, or devoured by a yogeśī through sorcery, or slain by yantra-tantra etc. by the guru — the dead.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ḍimbāhatasya yogeśībhakṣitasyābhicārataḥ mṛtasya guruṇā yantratantrādinihatasya vā
